subject.title: fix: honor configured default agent across main paths

question: Should this broader default-agent fix become the canonical landing path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90573 instead of the narrower secrets-only PR?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same canonical issue, but this PR changes session-state, auth/model discovery, setup paths, and audit labels while the other only fixes secrets discovery.

options.title: Use This Broad PR
options.body: Require current-head real behavior proof, then review this PR as the canonical fix and close or supersede the narrower secrets-only PR after merge.

options.title: Land Secrets First
options.body: Keep this PR open but land the narrower secrets-only repair first, leaving session/setup/audit surfaces tracked by the canonical issue.

options.title: Pause Both
options.body: Keep both PRs open until a maintainer defines the exact default-agent compatibility contract for non-main deployments.

recommendation.body: Require current-head real behavior proof, then review this PR as the canonical fix and close or supersede the narrower secrets-only PR after merge.
